RealFireSmoke data access

Applications are not yet open. Access will be granted through a reviewed data-use application.

What the dataset contains

  • 1,500 de-identified RGB test frames from 50 clips at the held-out viewpoint.
  • Exposure-matched evaluation references, scoring masks and estimated transmission.
  • Calibrated smoke fields from 30 even-numbered clips at the training viewpoint.

Staff regions were replaced with synthesized background. Replacement occasionally covers part of the fire or a gas cylinder. Replaced input pixels are excluded from scoring.

For the acquisition and evaluation protocol, see the paper.
